subject: Request: brief demo keepalive while PO clears
messages:
From: Jordan Meyers <jordan@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 09:12:35 -0700
Subject: Request: brief demo keepalive while PO clears

Hi Michael / Camila,

Quick note — procurement flagged our PO for an additional compliance review this morning. The legal/finance team says clearance should happen this week but it may not be finalized until early next week. We’re in the middle of a 10-day internal pilots window and losing access would stall our evaluation with clinical stakeholders.

Is there any way Redwood can keep our sandbox/demo live for an extra 5 business days (or provide a short-term credit) while the PO route completes? We’d be happy to sign a short MSA addendum or provide the PO number once the review finishes.

Attaching the in-flight PO and the contact at procurement (procurement@clearlinehealth.com) for reference.

Attachment: Clearline_PO_1234.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Meyers
Senior PM, Clearline Health
jordan@clearlinehealth.com
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Meyers <jordan@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: brief demo keepalive while PO clears

Hi Jordan — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the PO. Sorry to hear the review added friction.

We can do a short-term bridge to keep the pilot alive. Proposed option: a one-time $500 sandbox credit (covers ~5–7 days at your current usage profile) and a 7-day auto-extension of the demo seat while the PO is in flight. Conditions:
- Credit applied to your sandbox project only (no exports, no production access).
- Valid for 7 days from the time we enable it.
- We’ll require the PO number or copy of the cleared PO once procurement finishes; the credit is contingent on receiving confirmation of intent to purchase (PO in process is fine).

If that works, I’ll ask Camila/Finance to approve and apply the credit this afternoon. If you prefer a shorter window or a different amount, tell me and we’ll adjust.

Next step from our side: Camila, can we approve a single $500 sponsorship for D-8462? I’ll note it as a customer-success-sponsored keepalive.

Best,
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0198
michael@redwood.com
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 11:45:01 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: brief demo keepalive while PO clears

Michael — fine with a one-time $500 credit to preserve the pilot. Please mark the internal note: sponsorship code 'SPONS-D8462', apply to sandbox project 'clearline-eval', and set expiry to 2026-09-23 11:00 PT.

Grace — can you log this in finance as a sponsored credit and create a tracking line so GL is adjusted? No refund needed; treat as pre-sales promotion tied to deal D-8462. If you need the PO copy to finalize the bookkeeping entry, let me know — Jordan attached Clearline_PO_1234.pdf earlier.

Also adding the public facing restriction: credit cannot be used to provision Dedicated/Private instances.

Camila Reyes
Lead, Customer Success Operations
camila@redwood.com
